_note: v2.4 plan 02 follow-up E2 live gate (00-overview Decisions E2; 02 gate record 'Follow-ups E2-E5' NOT done list). Real generation. Run: node scripts/debug/st-lanes.mts batch --lanes 1 --repeat 2 --strict --group 1759606632088 test/scenarios/live-v24-02-e2-solo-epistemic.json. The sandbox starts in the group and each half moves to a NEW solo chat of 'DM Narrator' (solo_chat, owned by the run and deleted by its cleanup), because the solo render path runs only with no active group (memoryInjector.ts update(): getActiveGroup() ? '' : ... renderSoloEpistemicBlock; roster.ts enabledCharacterIds answers [] outside a group, so activeSpeakerId is null and the solo renderer is used). Half 1: a story whose roster is Arin + Ponticius; five epistemic rows are seeded through applyExtractionAudit (plumbing, not the path under test), the injected block and {{story_epistemic}} must equal the attributed block byte for byte, then a REAL generation (send_generate) runs and the block is cut out of the request ST actually sent (GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, every string leaf of the request) at its header and compared byte for byte: one line per row, grouped Arin then Ponticius, tag order knows/suspects/believes/unaware/hiding, no second-person line (J5.8 rule: asserted inside the block, never across the body). Half 2 (control): a story whose roster is Arin alone, same rows: the block ST sent must be the second-person renderPrivateEpistemicBlock output byte for byte (unaware rows and Ponticius rows are not in it) and the attributed header must be absent.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const NL = String.fromCharCode(10); const leaves = (value, out = []) => { if (typeof value === 'string') out.push(value); else if (Array.isArray(value)) value.forEach((item) => leaves(item, out)); else if (value && typeof value === 'object') Object.values(value).forEach((item) => leaves(item, out)); return out; }; if (globalThis.__e2Listener) ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, globalThis.__e2Listener); globalThis.__e2 = { requests: [], results: {} }; globalThis.__e2Listener = (data, dryRun) => { if (dryRun) return; globalThis.__e2.requests.push({ chatId: SillyTavern.getContext().chatId ?? null, groupId: SillyTavern.getContext().groupId ?? null, text: leaves(data).join(NL) }); }; ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, globalThis.__e2Listener); globalThis.__e2.region = (text, header) => { const at = text.indexOf(header); if (at < 0) return null; const lines = [header]; for (const line of text.slice(at + header.length).split(NL).slice(1)) { if (!line.startsWith('- ')) break; lines.push(line); } return lines.join(NL); }; globalThis.__e2.count = (text, needle) => text.split(needle).length - 1; return { listening: true };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (ctx.groupId || ctx.chat.length) throw new Error(`expected an empty solo chat: ${JSON.stringify({ group: ctx.groupId, messages: ctx.chat.length })}`); for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((name) => name.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; return { chatId: ctx.chatId, character: ctx.name2 };

import_story.title: SO-E2 Solo Epistemic Multi
import_story.description: v2.4 plan 02 follow-up E2 live fixture: a solo chat whose story roster is Arin, Ponticius.

checkpoints.name: Toll gate
checkpoints.objective: Arin and Ponticius reach the toll gate.

steps.eval:
const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (ctx.groupId) throw new Error(`E2 is the SOLO path: the page is in group ${ctx.groupId}`); rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0 }); if (!rt.getSnapshot().memory.settings.epistemicLedgerCapable) throw new Error('the epistemic/ledger capability is off on this install, so no epistemic block is ever injected'); const audit = { id: 'e2-seed-multi', createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), priority: 0, reason: 'manual', contractHash: 'h', scope: [], window: { from: 0, to: 0 }, prompt: 'p', rawResponse: 'r', acceptedDeltas: [], rejected: [] }; await rt.applyExtractionAudit(audit, [], [], [], [ { tag: 'knows', subject: 'Arin', content: 'the north road washed out' }, { tag: 'suspects', subject: 'Arin', content: 'Ponticius forged the toll writ' }, { tag: 'hiding', subject: 'Arin', hiddenFrom: 'Ponticius', content: 'the ledger key is in his boot' }, { tag: 'believes', subject: 'Ponticius', content: 'the caravan left at dawn' }, { tag: 'unaware', subject: 'Ponticius', content: 'Arin holds the ledger key' } ], []); const expected = "What each character privately knows (voice each character accordingly — a character acts only on what they know, and never reveal what one of them conceals):
- Arin knows: the north road washed out
- Arin suspects Ponticius forged the toll writ
- Arin is concealing from Ponticius: the ledger key is in his boot
- Ponticius believes the caravan left at dawn
- Ponticius is unaware that Arin holds the ledger key"; const injected = ctx.extensionPrompts?.story_orchestrator_epistemic?.value ?? ''; const macro = ctx.substituteParams('{{story_epistemic}}'); globalThis.__e2.results['multi'] = { expected, injected, macro, rows: rt.getEpistemic().length, chatId: ctx.chatId }; if (injected !== expected) throw new Error(`multi: the injected epistemic block is not the expected one: ${JSON.stringify({ injected, expected })}`); if (macro !== expected) throw new Error(`multi: {{story_epistemic}} differs from the injected block: ${JSON.stringify({ macro, injected })}`); globalThis.__e2.mark = globalThis.__e2.requests.length; return { rows: rt.getEpistemic().length, injectedLines: injected.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).length };

send_generate.text: Arin and Ponticius reach the toll gate at dusk. Describe what each of them does.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const NL = String.fromCharCode(10); const state = globalThis.__e2; const expected = state.results['multi'].expected; const chatId = state.results['multi'].chatId; const sent = state.requests.slice(state.mark).filter((request) => request.chatId === chatId && !request.groupId); if (!sent.length) throw new Error(`multi: no main-generation request was captured (GENERATE_AFTER_DATA) for the solo chat ${chatId}; captured ${state.requests.length - state.mark} since the mark`); const first = sent[0]; const header = "What each character privately knows (voice each character accordingly — a character acts only on what they know, and never reveal what one of them conceals):"; const other = "Your private knowledge (stay in character — never narrate what you conceal or do not know):"; const block = state.region(first.text, header); const occurrences = state.count(first.text, header); state.results['multi'].sent = { requests: sent.length, occurrences, block }; if (!block) throw new Error(`multi: the request ST sent carries no epistemic block (header ${JSON.stringify(header.slice(0, 40))} absent)`); if (occurrences !== 1) throw new Error(`multi: the header appears ${occurrences} times in the request`); const at = first.text.indexOf(expected); state.results['multi'].sent.tail = at < 0 ? null : first.text.slice(at + expected.length, at + expected.length + 12); if (at < 0) throw new Error(`multi: the request ST sent does not carry the expected block byte for byte: ${JSON.stringify({ sent: block, expected })}`); if (first.text.startsWith(NL + '- ', at + expected.length)) throw new Error(`multi: the block in the request ST sent runs past the expected lines: ${JSON.stringify(block)}`); if (first.text.includes(other)) throw new Error(`multi: the request also carries the other renderer's header ${JSON.stringify(other.slice(0, 40))}`); const lines = expected.split(NL).slice(1); const unattributed = lines.filter((line) => !/^- (Arin|Ponticius) /.test(line)); if (unattributed.length) throw new Error(`multi: lines not attributed to a subject: ${JSON.stringify(unattributed)}`); if (lines.some((line) => /^- You\b/.test(line))) throw new Error(`multi: a second-person line survived in the attributed block`); return { requests: sent.length, block: first.text.slice(at, at + expected.length), after: state.results['multi'].sent.tail };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (ctx.groupId || ctx.chat.length) throw new Error(`expected an empty solo chat: ${JSON.stringify({ group: ctx.groupId, messages: ctx.chat.length })}`); if (ctx.chatId === globalThis.__e2.results.multi.chatId) throw new Error('the control reused the first solo chat'); return { chatId: ctx.chatId };
